newsitem.title: USA: Benguet, Golden Cycle set effort.
newsitem.headline: Benguet, Golden Cycle set effort.

text.p: Benguet Corp said it signed a minerals project agreement Tuesday with Golden Cycle Philippines Inc creating a joint venture to seek and develop mineral deposits in the Philippines.
In a statement released in New York Wednesday, Benguet said the initial focus of exploration activities will be in Southern Philippines, particularly in Eastern Mindanao.

It said both companies will contribute capital, technical know-how and management expertise and it is expected that GCPI will bring into this undertaking foreign investment of its parent company, Golden Cycle Gold Corp, a Colorado-based gold mining company. ((-- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.))
